description.text: Duration of Study The study of CS&T program lasts 4 years in all and is composed of two periods. The first period of teaching and the last six months is for the students’ practice. It opens only when there are over 10 applicants. Objectives The major trains enroll students to produce quality engineers of computer software and hardware in design, development and applications. By study, students can master the fundamental theories and basic techniques of computer software and hardware; eligible to analysis, design and develop software; eligible to use, develop and maintain hardware; eligible to operate and maintain computer networks. The Key Courses The key courses which will be instructed in the first period of 3.5 years include: Introduction on Computer & Base on C Program Database Principle Programming in C Computer Network Computer Practice Technology of Compile Sports (I-III) Computer Architecture Advanced Mathematics A(I-II) Principles of Microcomputer and Interfacing Technology Probability Statistics Information Retrieval Java Programming English of Technical Terms Software Engineering Digital Logic Circuit Design ERP System Discrete Mathematics Digital Image Processing Data Structure Computer Graphics Operating System1 Financial Administration Electrotechnics Adjust accounts of Cost Computer Organization C# Programming Please click here to download the timetable of subjects

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Jiangsu University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate Not needed during application. But may required when applying for visa 6. Family Finance Support Photocopy of the financial support statement with signature 7. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.

requirements.text: 1. Be in good health condition, which accords with the Health Standard for International Students stipulated by the China Education Department; 2. Have senior high school diploma and good academic record; 3. Have basic English language ability; 4. Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and regulations of the university. Respect Chinese social customs and habits.
